label: IMMENSE_2 is present to all whenever they are, from weak sustaining and contact (inference)
rule: Creator conjunct of IMMENSE_2 at each other present thing, through presence-in-act; weak sustaining reading; contact
meaning: New non-transcription conditional derivation of the immensity presence step 9469ab62 with the weak sustaining reading in place of 23e04ae5.
